lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Technical data sheet - AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
Binder: long-oil alkyd resin. Anti-corrosive pigment: zinc phosphate.
Fineness of grind: 6 Hegman minimum (dispersion quality, gloss and anti-corrosion
Viscosity: Ford cup No. 4, 80-110 s; adjusted with white spirit at letdown.
Drying: oxidative, Co/Zr drier system; MEKO prevents skinning in the tin. Gloss 60°: 80 GU
Filtration: 50 µm (required by OEM spray-application customers).
